scenario.name: r-cd-return-covenant-authority
scenario.description: One indivisible product-owned return-covenant matrix executes all 12 lifecycle cases in typed-tool then bracket-token order.
scenario.registryNotes: The accepted path is the process-local launcher and contract scenario, not the generic live gateway runner. The 24 observations cannot be split or spliced. The row must carry a manifest regardless of its runnability: check-proof-row-manifests.mjs is run-proofs.sh's catalog preflight and fails closed on any corpus row without one, which blocks every runnable row rather than only this one.

invocation.fixtureState: exact clean product checkout, attested read-only runtime artifact, isolated state/config, and product-owned fixture driver

expectedReceipts.name: exact-product-build-identity
expectedReceipts.description: Candidate commit/tree, runtime artifact, package manager, Node, and tracked command identities are exact and immutable.

expectedReceipts.name: product-owned-schema-fixture
expectedReceipts.description: Fresh v19, both v18 upgrade profiles, and idempotent v19 reopen are exercised through the tracked product fixture.

expectedReceipts.name: accepted-held-dispatch
expectedReceipts.description: Each form records an accepted held result and captured recipient generation before the lifecycle transition.

expectedReceipts.name: recipient-generation-diagnostic
expectedReceipts.description: Captured and current recipient generations are observed from product-owned authority.

expectedReceipts.name: lifecycle-transition
expectedReceipts.description: All seven allowed and five forbidden lifecycle edges execute in the accepted serial order.

expectedReceipts.name: queue-admission-disposition
expectedReceipts.description: Allowed results are admitted exactly once and stale or revoked results are acknowledged and removed.

expectedReceipts.name: prompt-wake-channel-effect-counts
expectedReceipts.description: Allowed cases match configured effects and forbidden cases prove zero prompt adoption, wake, and channel delivery.

expectedReceipts.name: bounded-transcript-and-system-event-scan
expectedReceipts.description: Successor transcript and trusted system-event scans corroborate every final-effect count.

expectedReceipts.name: signed-authoritative-receipt
expectedReceipts.description: One signed receipt binds the complete 12-case and 24-observation matrix.

expectedReceipts.name: cleanup
expectedReceipts.description: The isolated process group, state, config, control, and writable runtime roots are fully cleaned.

review.notes: PASS requires the complete indivisible matrix, signed authority, and cleanup receipt. No subset or historical observation transfers authority.

liveRunSafety.notes: The generic live-run guard must reject this row. Execute only with the accepted process-local runtime-artifact builder and launcher.

placeholderAudit.reason: The placeholder was catalogued when no producer was known to exist. The producer does exist: contracts/return-covenant-authority/scenario.js and its launcher, restored on this line from 7bec111d. This manifest replaces the placeholder's construct-only declaration with the producer's contract.

receiptMapping.transition-http-body: lifecycle-transition + signed-authoritative-receipt; the receipt requires the transition body be non-empty, byte-length-consistent and SHA-256-bound (response.bodySha256), which is stricter than 'retained'.
receiptMapping.replacement-process-output: lifecycle-transition; return-covenant-gateway-listener captures replacement stdout and stderr and threads both into every failure path.
receiptMapping.generation-fingerprints: recipient-generation-diagnostic; return-covenant-process-observer derives startFingerprint=sha256(pid:startTicks) plus a namespace-aware variant across the whole descendant tree.
receiptMapping.observation-record: prompt-wake-channel-effect-counts + bounded-transcript-and-system-event-scan over the indivisible 24-observation matrix; the placeholder's baseline produced zero of twenty-four.

placeholderAudit.restartCase: The placeholder described the gateway-restart control as the whole row. The harness carries it as lifecycle edge 'allowed-gateway-restart-replay' with restartBetweenAcceptanceAndRelease=true, one of the twelve cases. The restart evidence is therefore required by the matrix, not dropped with the placeholder.
placeholderAudit.rejectedBase: Retained from the placeholder: the first gateway-restart transition cleared the current generation before the replacement became usable and the exact failure body was lost. The historical-baseline-review attempt reached readiness and read-only mounts but failed fixture gateway phase calls, yielding zero of 24 observations and no signed cleanup/observer receipt.
